_comment: A template and test fixture, not an attestation. A real one lives at the approved path
supabase/.audit/attestation.json, is git-ignored, is never uploaded, and names the project
reference the audit is pointed at so it cannot be applied to a different project.
Every item must be attested true with a sentence of evidence naming where it was seen;
an item attested with no evidence is not accepted, and an absent item is reported unproven.

data_api_disabled.evidence: Dashboard, Project Settings, API: Exposed schemas is empty and the Data API is off.

storage_buckets_all_private.evidence: Dashboard, Storage: every bucket lists as Private; there are zero storage policies.

no_privileged_key_in_deployments.evidence: Render, Cloudflare and GitHub secret stores reviewed; no service_role or sb_secret key is configured, and no browser bundle carries one.

backups_configured.evidence: Dashboard, Database, Backups: daily backups enabled; the independent bucket-backup job is scheduled.

database_restore_drill_passed.evidence: Restore drill run into a scratch project; the seven schemas and 33 tables came back.

bucket_restore_drill_passed.evidence: Bucket restore drill run from the independent backup; object hashes matched.

security_advisors_clean.evidence: Dashboard, Advisors: zero Security findings and nothing above INFO on Performance.
